item.title: Hermantown Boys Hockey Wins 6th Straight Game, Taking Down Delano 7-3
item.description: HERMANTOWN, Minn.- The Hermantown boys hockey team was back at their home barn on Friday, taking on Delano. The Hawks remain undefeated, taking down the Tigers 7-3. The Hawks are back to work on Saturday, December 27th, against White Bear Lake. Puck drop is at 7 p.m. Categories: Friday Night Frenzy, High School, Sports

item.title: Hermantown Boys Hockey Holds on Against White Bear Lake to Stay Undefeated
item.description: HERMANTOWN, Minn.- The Hermantown boys hockey team picked up win number ten on Saturday. The Hawks defeated White Bear Lake 3-2, improving to 10-0-2. Hermantown is back in action on Saturday, January 3rd, against Eden Prairie. Puck drop is at 1 p.m. Categories: Community, High School, Sports
